page.layout: One blank leaf with no printed text. Top right: a handwritten shelf mark. Bottom: a handwritten inscription (an owner's name). Dark library tabs at the upper right and lower centre. Digitiser's watermark at lower right.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The handwritten shelf mark at top right and the handwritten inscription at the foot are manuscript, not print, so they are not transcribed. The library tabs, stains and the "Digitized by Google" watermark are excluded. Faint orange-brown horizontal marks across the leaf are foxing or show-through.
